description: The fixed 8-prompt speed set for the speed-core lane (criteria 5-6). Prompts 1-6 are varied realistic Maple asks the host tools can serve; prompts 7-8 are the historically-failing fabricating-island class (asks that invite invented data — no host tool serves the values, so islands tend to fabricate constants; see packages/apps/src/generation/engine.ts island-scoped repair comment).

prompts.prompt: Build me a net-worth dashboard with my total balance, a balance-over-time chart, and my recent transactions.
Build a subscriptions manager showing my recurring charges, the monthly total, and which subscriptions changed recently.
Make a budget tracker showing each budget category, how much I've spent so far this month, and which categories are over budget.
Build a savings goals board with each goal's progress, plus a summary of this month's cash inflow and outflow so I can see what I could put toward them.
Make a card spending view: list my cards, recent charges on each, and my spending by category this month.
Build an upcoming bills view with my scheduled payments, my saved payees, and recent notifications.
Build me an investment portfolio tracker with live prices for my stock holdings and a today's-market-movers panel.
Make a currency exchange dashboard with live USD to EUR and GBP rates, a rate-history chart, and a converter for my checking balance.
